36478-the-red-year-a-story-of-the-indian.title: Of The Indian Mutiny
36478-the-red-year-a-story-of-the-indian.creator: Louis Tracy
36478-the-red-year-a-story-of-the-indian.description: A book by Louis Tracy. The sepoy started as though a snake had stung him. Lascars, the sailor-men of India, were notoriously free-and-easy in their manners. Yet how came it that even a low-caste mongrel of a Lascar should offer such an overt insult to a Brahmin!

arxiv-1807-02162.title: Feature Assisted bi-directional LSTM Model for Protein-Protein Interaction Identification from Biomedical Texts Journal: Knowledge-Based Systems
arxiv-1807-02162.creator: Shweta Yadav, Ankit Kumar, Asif Ekbal, Sriparna Saha and Pushpak Bhattacharyya
arxiv-1807-02162.description: Abstract Knowledge about protein-protein interactions is essential in understanding the biological processes such as metabolic pathways, DNA replication, and transcription etc. However, a majority of the existing Protein-Protein Interaction (PPI) systems are dependent primarily on the scientific literature, which is yet not accessible as a structured database.

arxiv-2104-08871.title: Cohomologies and generalized derivation extensions of n n -Lie algebras
arxiv-2104-08871.creator: B. Ateşli, O. Esen, S. Sütlü
arxiv-2104-08871.description: Abstract . A cohomology theory, associated to a n n -Lie algebra and a representation space of it, is introduced. It is observed that this cohomology theory is qualified to encode the generalized derivation extensions, and that it coincides, for n = 3 n=3 , with the known cohomology of n n -Lie algebras.

arxiv-2108-11150.title: Boussinesq’s equations for (2+1)-dimensional surface gravity waves in an ideal fluid model
arxiv-2108-11150.creator: Anna Karczewska, Piotr Rozmej
arxiv-2108-11150.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Anna Karczewska, Piotr Rozmej. We study the problem of gravity surface waves for the ideal fluid model in (2+1)-dimensional case. We apply a systematic procedure for deriving the Boussinesq equations for a prescribed relationship between the orders of four expansion parameters, the amplitude parameter α \alpha , the long-wavelength parameter β \beta , the transverse wavelength parameter γ \gamma , and the bottom variation parameter δ \delta . We also take into account surface tension effects when relevant.

arxiv-2109-14259.title: Hierarchical Character Tagger for Short Text Spelling Error Correction
arxiv-2109-14259.creator: Mengyi Gao, Canran Xu, Peng Shi
arxiv-2109-14259.description: Abstract State-of-the-art approaches to spelling error correction problem include Transformer-based Seq2Seq models, which require large training sets and suffer from slow inference time; and sequence labeling models based on Transformer encoders like BERT, which involve token-level label space and therefore a large pre-defined vocabulary dictionary.

arxiv-2202-08500.title: Causal inference with recurrent and competing events
arxiv-2202-08500.creator: Matias Janvin 1 , Jessica G. Young 2,3,4 , Pål C. Ryalen 5 , Mats J. Stensrud 1
arxiv-2202-08500.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Matias Janvin 1 , Jessica G. Young 2,3,4 , Pål C. Ryalen 5 , Mats J. Stensrud 1. Many research questions concern treatment effects on outcomes that can recur several times in the same individual. For example, medical researchers are interested in treatment effects on hospitalizations in heart failure patients and sports injuries in athletes. Competing events, such as death, complicate causal inference in studies of recurrent events because once a competing event occurs, an individual cannot have more recurrent events.

arxiv-2208-01769.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Multi-Agent Interaction Volume: 0
arxiv-2208-01769.creator: I.H.Ibrahim H. Ahmedlabel=e1]i.ahmed@ed.ac.uk, C.B.Cillian Brewittlabel=e2]cillian.brewitt@ed.ac.uk, I.C.Ignacio Carlucholabel=e3]ignacio.carlucho@ed.ac.uk, F.C.Filippos Christianoslabel=e4]f.christianos@ed.ac.uk, M.D.Mhairi Dunionlabel=e5]mhairi.dunion@ed.ac.uk, E.F.Elliot Fosonglabel=e6]e.fosong@e
arxiv-2208-01769.description: Abstract The development of autonomous agents which can interact with other agents to accomplish a given task is a core area of research in artificial intelligence and machine learning. Towards this goal, the Autonomous Agents Research Group develops novel machine learning algorithms for autonomous systems control, with a specific focus on deep reinforcement learning and multi-agent reinforcement learning.

arxiv-2309-13256.title: Defending Pre-trained Language Models as Few-shot Learners against Backdoor Attacks
arxiv-2309-13256.creator: Zhaohan Xi, Tianyu Du, Changjiang Li, Ren Pang, Shouling Ji, Jinghui Chen Fenglong Ma Ting Wang
arxiv-2309-13256.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zhaohan Xi, Tianyu Du, Changjiang Li, Ren Pang, Shouling Ji, Jinghui Chen Fenglong Ma Ting Wang. † † footnotetext: ∗ Equal contribution. Pre-trained language models (PLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance as few-shot learners. However, their security risks under such settings are largely unexplored. In this work, we conduct a pilot study showing that PLMs as few-shot learners are highly vulnerable to backdoor attacks while existing defenses are inadequate due to the unique challenges of few-shot scenarios.

arxiv-2510-17379.title: Interplay of spin orbit interaction and Andreev reflection in proximized quantum dots
arxiv-2510-17379.creator: Bogdan R. Bułka, Tadeusz Domański, Karol I. Wysokiński
arxiv-2510-17379.description: Abstract We investigate a hybrid device, consisting of two quantum dots proximized by a BCS superconductor and coupled to two external normal electrodes. Assuming charge tunneling between quantum dots through the spin-flip processes, we study the molecular Andreev bound states appearing in the proximized quantum dots. We show that the spin-orbit coupling induces four quasiparticle states.

pmc-11377014.title: The Association between Drug-Related Problems and Length of Stay of Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Patients
pmc-11377014.creator: Niken Larasati, Satibi Satibi, Susi Ari Kristina, Lutfan Lazuardi
pmc-11377014.description: IntroductionDrug-related problems (DRPs) are treatment-related occurrences that affect therapeutic efficacy. In a previous study, approximately 279 out of 330 (84.5%) patients with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) had experienced at least one DRP, including non-optimal drug effects (n = 240, 52.7%) and indications without medication (n = 137, 30.1%).

pmc-11689342.title: ASSOCIATION BETWEEN PARTNER IDENTIFICATION AND EDUCATION WITH HOSPITAL LENGTH OF STAY FOR PATIENTS WITH DEMENTIA
pmc-11689342.creator: Nicole Werner, Austin Medlin, Beth Fields
pmc-11689342.description: Despite overwhelming reliance on care partners to care for people living with dementia (PLWD) after a hospitalization, care partners rarely receive adequate education to meet post-hospitalization caregiving demands, which is associated with health consequences including adverse clinical outcomes for PLWD, and increased levels of stress, depression, and morbidity for care partners.

pmc-12431858.title: Hbo1 and Msl complexes preserve differential compaction and H3K27me3 marking of active and inactive X chromosomes during mitosis
pmc-12431858.creator: Dounia Djeghloul, Sherry Cheriyamkunnel, Bhavik Patel, Holger Kramer, Alex Montoya, Karen E. Brown, Chad Whilding, Tatyana B. Nesterova, Guifeng Wei, Neil Brockdorff, Iga Grządzielewska, Remzi Karayol, Asifa Akhtar, Matthias Merkenschlager, Amanda G. Fisher
pmc-12431858.description: In mammals, chromosome-wide regulatory mechanisms ensure a balance of X-linked gene dosage between males (XY) and females (XX). In female cells, expression of genes from one of the two X chromosomes is curtailed, with selective accumulation of Xist-RNA, Xist-associated proteins, specific histone modifications (for example, H3K27me3) and Barr body formation observed throughout interphase.

pmc-12505216.title: Dual field magnetic separation for improved size fractionation of magnetic nanoparticles
pmc-12505216.creator: Manuel Wolfschwenger, Jonathan Leliaert, Aaron Jaufenthaler, Daniel Baumgarten
pmc-12505216.description: Magnetic nanoparticles (MNPs) are emerging as key tools in biomedical and technical applications due to their tunable magnetic properties and responsiveness to external magnetic fields. However, the effectiveness of MNPs in applications such as targeted drug delivery, magnetic imaging and magnetic hyperthermia critically depends on achieving a narrow particle size distribution.

pmc-12531332.title: Chromatin remodeling restrains oncogenic functions in prostate cancer
pmc-12531332.creator: Valentina Rosti, Giovanni Lembo, Cristiano Petrini, Francesca Gorini, Roberto Quadri, Chiara Cordiglieri, Margherita Mutarelli, Elisa Salviato, Elisabetta Casari, Emanuele Di Patrizio Soldateschi, Emanuele Montanari, Giancarlo Albo, Francesco Ripa, Alessandra Fasciani, Mariacristina Crosti, Elisa De
pmc-12531332.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Primary prostate cancer presents with multifocal lesions and unpredictable clinical behavior, posing significant challenges for effective prognosis. To address this, we investigate the epigenomic landscape of prostate tumor biopsies from 25 treatment-naïve male patients by analyzing chromatin compartmentalization patterns. Our analysis reveals two distinct molecular subtypes: one with a Low Degree of Decompartmentalization (LDD) and another with a High Degree of Decompartmentalization (HDD). Here we show that the HDD subgroup exhibits extensive chromatin reorganization associated with diminished oncogenic potential.

pmc-12652099.title: FCER1A Downregulation in Infectious Pneumonia: A Multi-Modal Study Combining Bioinformatics, Animal Models, and Reverse Pharmacology
pmc-12652099.creator: Yuan Cai, Xiaolong Feng, Mengxiong Xiao, Qian Li, Xinru Tao, Penghui Li, Quan Zou
pmc-12652099.description: Background: Infectious pneumonia remains a major global health challenge with high morbidity and mortality, especially among vulnerable groups. Current diagnostic approaches lack sufficient specificity and accuracy. This study aimed to identify core diagnostic genes, explore their biological functions, and predict potential natural compounds targeting these genes to improve diagnostic and therapeutic strategies.

pmc-12822195.title: The lived experiences and explanation of women’s postpartum sexual and reproductive health: a qualitative study
pmc-12822195.creator: Nazanin Rezaei, Masoumeh Namazi, Atbin Tahmasebi, Somayeh Moukhah, Zahra Behboodi Moghadam
pmc-12822195.description: BackgroundDespite the significance of the postpartum period, women’s postpartum sexual and reproductive health (SRH) has been neglected. This study examines women’s perceptions and experiences of SRH in the postpartum period.MethodsThis qualitative study utilized conventional content analysis. The research was conducted in health centers in Ilam city, Iran.

pmc-12930003.title: Axillary Recurrence After a Negative Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy (SLNB) for Initial Positive Node Breast Cancer Postneoadjuvant Therapy: Insights From a Systematic Review and Meta‐Analysis
pmc-12930003.creator: Maha A. Alghamdi, Hemali Deshpande, Walid M. Abd El Maksoud, Fahad S. Al Amri, Mohammed A. Bawahab, Khaled S. Abbas, Abdullah Dalboh, Hassan A. Alzahrani, Marei H. Alshandeer, Ahmad Jebril M. Bosaily, Haytham M. Fayed, Ibrahim A. Alghamdi
pmc-12930003.description: BackgroundDespite the use of sentinel lymph node biopsy (SLNB) to stage the axilla in clinically node‐negative breast cancer patients’ postneoadjuvant therapy, the incidence and clinical significance of axillary recurrence (AR) after a negative SLNB remain under‐explored in the literature. Understanding these factors is essential to improving patient outcomes and guiding future treatment strategies.

pmc-13430917.title: A pilot study assessing the feasibility of contrast-enhanced ultrasound for triaging fine-needle aspiration in lateral cervical lymph nodes of papillary thyroid carcinoma
pmc-13430917.creator: Dai Pan, Yuanbing Xu, Yichao Tao, Fen Huang, Cuiling Li
pmc-13430917.description: BackgroundTo explore the role of contrast-enhanced ultrasound (CEUS) in preoperative ultrasound-guided fine-needle aspiration (US-FNA) of lateral cervical lymph nodes (LCLN) in patients with papillary thyroid carcinoma (PTC).MethodsA total of 112 patients with 164 suspicious LCLN were enrolled into two cohorts based on whether they received CEUS examination before US-FNA.

pmc-13470210.title: The normal distance from soft tissue nasion to the arbitrary axis-orbital plane is similar in pediatric, adolescent, and young adult samples
pmc-13470210.creator: Aleš Čelar, Stefan Lettner, Erwin Jonke
pmc-13470210.description: Anatomical facebows establish the arbitrary axis-orbital plane by assessing both the hinge axis points and landmark orbitale. The estimated point orbitale results from the facebow’s nasion relator height of 25.4 mm. This height was investigated in adults but it is unclear if their anthropometric dimensions adequately translate to children and adolescents.
